title: Display Financial Data from data.json
description: Render charts, tables, and KPI cards in the dashboard content area using static data from data.json.
details: In the dashboard page (/app/dashboard/page.tsx), import and parse data from data.json. Display key metrics as KPI cards, a summary table of financial records, and at least one simple chart (e.g., bar or line chart) using a lightweight charting library or custom SVG. Ensure data is presented clearly and accessibly. Use TypeScript for type safety. Handle loading and error states gracefully.
test_strategy: Check that all data from data.json is displayed accurately in the dashboard. Validate that KPIs, tables, and charts update if data.json changes. Confirm accessibility of all data visualizations and tables.

title: Implement Authentication Redirects
description: Ensure only authenticated users can access the dashboard, redirecting unauthenticated users to the sign-in page.
details: In /app/dashboard/page.tsx and/or layout.tsx, implement server-side or client-side logic to check for a valid JWT/session. If the user is not authenticated, redirect them to /signin. Use Next.js middleware or server components as appropriate. Ensure the redirect is secure and cannot be bypassed.
test_strategy: Test by accessing /dashboard as an authenticated and unauthenticated user. Confirm unauthenticated users are redirected to /signin and authenticated users can access the dashboard.

title: Add Logout Functionality to Dashboard Header
description: Enable users to securely log out from the dashboard via a button in the header.
details: Add a logout button to the dashboard header. On click, clear the user's JWT/session (e.g., by calling the /api/auth endpoint or clearing cookies) and redirect to the sign-in page. Provide user feedback on logout (e.g., loading spinner or confirmation). Ensure the logout process is secure and cannot be bypassed.
test_strategy: Log in, then click the logout button. Confirm the session is invalidated and the user is redirected to /signin. Attempt to access /dashboard after logout to ensure access is denied.

title: Create Dashboard Layout Component
description: Implement the main layout for the dashboard, including header, sidebar, and content area, under /app/dashboard/layout.tsx.
details: Develop a reusable layout component in /app/dashboard/layout.tsx. The layout should include a consistent header (with app branding and logout button), a sidebar for navigation (even if only one link for now), and a central content area. Use semantic HTML and ensure accessibility (ARIA labels, keyboard navigation). Apply global and theme CSS for styling. Ensure the layout is responsive for desktop and basic mobile views.
test_strategy: Manually verify layout renders correctly on /dashboard, header/sidebar are visible, and content area is accessible. Test keyboard navigation and basic responsiveness. Check for correct application of global and theme CSS.
